interface.longDescription: Northvalley Intelligence is a custom-software and agent-native service studio for local businesses, based in Marietta, Georgia. This plugin's purpose is to help you learn what Northvalley offers, request a one-page Website Growth Assessment for a business website, or request a consultation about custom software, workflow automation, or making a business reachable from inside AI assistants. Northvalley reviews every request by hand and follows up by email; nothing is scheduled, confirmed, purchased, or committed automatically, and no payment is collected. The complete assessment is a separate engagement; its findings are never returned through this plugin.
